# Theatre Compliance

> > Theatre Compliance provides compliance and safety services for the entertainment and theatre industry across Australia.

Theatre Compliance operates from multiple locations including Sydney, Chatswood, Parramatta (NSW), Canberra, Manuka (ACT), and Melbourne (VIC), offering specialized compliance solutions for theatrical venues and entertainment facilities.

## Key Topics

- Theatre Compliance

- Sydney office locations
- NSW operations (Chatswood, Parramatta)
- ACT operations (Canberra, Manuka)
- VIC operations (Melbourne)
- Australian entertainment industry compliance
- Contact and office locations
- Multi-state service coverage
